description: Approved HTTP request through change.propose/v1. operation=POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE matches request.method; target.locator equals request.path or request.url. One SET /request value={request:{method,path,base_url?,query?,headers?,body?}}; alternatively supply url instead of path/base_url. Relative path is appended to the registered root, including its base path. With multiple roots choose a registered base_url or a full URL under one root. Credentials are platform supplied. precondition and evidence_refs may be omitted; no pre-GET, read_back or JSON checks are required. verification uses HTTP_RESPONSE and may be omitted. The request is sent once; 2xx confirms an HTTP response, 202 means accepted. Inspect the response file and interpret business results yourself. A timeout or unknown result is never automatically resent.
title: http.write/v1 request
